recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the Airbyte/Snowflake/dbt/Power BI stack as overkill. For this week it recommends keeping the raw export untouched in an input folder and writing one small Python/pandas script that groups by month and region, sums the signed net amount so refunds stay negative, and writes a board report file. It adds proposed reconciliation checks (totals match the source, negatives included, no missing regions or dates). The stack is only mentioned as a possible move later if volume or sources grow. Nothing new is deployed now. The reply has none of the four required record labels.
note: I classed the pandas script over the existing export as SMALL because it is a bounded aggregation with no warehouse, ingestion, modeling or BI layer, but none of the four record labels are present, so all four predicates are false.
